map.本卦+变卦解读：起卦得本卦与动爻，依“动爻数”定解读重心（无动爻看本卦卦辞、一爻: Primary + changed hexagram reading: cast to obtain the primary hexagram and moving lines, then set the reading focus by the number of moving lines (no moving line reads the primary judgment; one moving line reads that line's text, etc.).
map.爻位分析：看用爻在第几爻（初/二/三/四/五/上）及阴阳、当位（阳居阳位、阴居阴: Line-position analysis: see which line is in use (initial / 2nd / 3rd / 4th / 5th / top) and whether it is yang or yin, and whether it is 'in position' (yang on a yang position, yin on a yin position), to judge the timing and fortune.
map.卦德与象数：结合上下卦卦德（乾健坤顺、坎陷离丽等）与互卦、之卦，综合给出象数层面: Hexagram virtue and image-number: combine the virtues of the upper and lower trigrams (Qian is strong, Kun is yielding, Kan is perilous, Li is clinging, etc.) with the nuclear and resultant hexagrams to give an integrated image-number reading.
map.以「水火既济」初爻变为例: Example: the initial line change of "Shui Huo Ji Ji (Water and Fire, After Completion)"
map.既济（䷾，离下坎上，水在火上）初九爻变则成水雷屯（䷂）。依古法“一爻变则看本卦变: Ji Ji (䷾, Li below Kan above, water over fire): when the initial yang line changes it becomes Shui Lei Zhun (䷂, Water and Thunder, Difficulty at the Beginning). By the ancient rule 'one moving line reads the changed line's text': Ji Ji's initial yang line says 'drag the wheel, wet the tail, no blame', meaning at the start of a matter one should stay steady and not rush. Combining the initial line's 'beginning of the matter' with Ji Ji's 'already accomplished' image yields the reading 'even at the start of success, proceed with caution'.
map.变爻数量不同怎么解读？: How to read different numbers of moving lines?
map.传统《周易》占法：无变爻看本卦卦辞；一爻变看变爻爻辞；二爻变看本卦两变爻爻辞、以: Traditional Zhouyi divination: no moving line reads the primary judgment; one moving line reads that line's text; two moving lines read both changed lines' texts, the upper one dominant; three moving lines read the primary and changed judgments; four moving lines read the two unchanged lines of the changed hexagram; five moving lines read the one unchanged line of the changed hexagram; all six changing reads the changed judgment (Qian and Kun use 'Use Nine / Use Six'). This tool locates the reading focus by these rules.
map.什么叫“当位”和“乘承比应”？: What are "being in position" and "overriding, supporting, adjacent, corresponding"?
map.当位指阳爻居初/三/五（阳位）、阴爻居二/四/上（阴位）为得位，反之为失位；乘承: 'Being in position' means a yang line on an odd position (1/3/5, yang positions) or a yin line on an even position (2/4/6, yin positions) is proper; otherwise it is improper. 'Overriding, supporting, adjacent, corresponding' describes line relationships (support = lower bears upper; override = upper presses lower; adjacent = neighboring; correspond = initial-4th / 2nd-5th / 3rd-top respond). These are common terms in hexagram interpretation for refining fortune judgment.
